description: This PHP source file defines the PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It configures menu items for the PIM (Personal Information Management) section in the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the left menu. The class uses various traits for authentication, controller, module screen helpers, and menu services, and includes a method to configure menu items based on user attributes and request parameters.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the left menu items for the PIM module based on user authentication and request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures and returns a MenuItem if the authenticated user’s employee number matches the request's employee number; otherwise overrides the screen to 'viewEmployeeList' and returns null.
